name: brief-check
description: Supervisor: does a subagent brief carry every item the phase's checklist requires? One noul per item; code computes missing_any and blocks the dispatch in gate mode (#127).

fields.brief: the brief text as it would be sent (clipped)
fields.checklist: the items this phase requires, by name (from the caller)

names_owned_paths.instructions: Does `brief` name which files or directories the agent may write, or which it must not touch?

criteria.true: An explicit list or rule of paths the agent owns or must leave alone.

carries_gate_commands.instructions: Does `brief` give the exact gate or verification commands to run (a script invocation with its arguments), rather than asking to 'verify' or 'check' in general?

cites_contract_sections.instructions: Does `brief` point at the contract the work must obey by name or section — an editability contract, a section schema, a reference document heading, numbered rules?

requires_ledger_lines.instructions: Does `brief` require the agent to write ledger or progress entries (a phase start/end line, a progress file, a verdict line back to the coordinator)?

forbids_shortcuts.instructions: Does `brief` forbid the shortcuts this work is prone to — DOM copying, eyeballing instead of measuring, weakening a gate, editing frozen files, fixed sleeps?

bounded_scope.instructions: Does `brief` bound the work — a named page or template, a page list, a unit — so the agent knows when it is done?
